subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's downstream stuck-recovery classification be accepted as the session-state replay boundary for active model calls versus active side-effecting tools?
rationale: The code path intentionally changes failover semantics for stuck recovery, and a wrong owner-boundary choice can affect retries, side-effect replay, and session recovery availability even with green tests.

options.title: Accept After Owner Review
options.body: Have the session-state owner confirm the model-call/tool/stale classification boundary and then land this PR in the chosen order with the cron timeout-budget work.

options.title: Ask For Narrower Semantics
options.body: Require another revision that keeps more stuck-recovery cases external-abort-like or adds a stricter owner-approved guard before fallback can run.

options.title: Close As Provider-Only
options.body: Treat the merged opencode-go provider fix as sufficient and close this downstream hardening PR without changing generic recovery semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept After Owner Review
recommendation.body: Have the session-state owner confirm the model-call/tool/stale classification boundary and then land this PR in the chosen order with the cron timeout-budget work.
